LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdVoidJumpDesc: Tear through the void and jump to a random star within {1} light-years. Burns {0} bioferrite from the map, needs no warp drive and takes 6 hours. Something may come back with you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgVoidJump: {0} tore through the void. The trip will take a few hours.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterVoidStowawayLabel: Something came back from the void
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterVoidStowaway: The void jump brought passengers. Void hungers are inside the ship, draining the air.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterGhostShip: Sensors found a ship drifting nearby. It answers no calls and shows no life signs, but the holds look full. Something sleeps inside.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterSilentStation: An abandoned station showed up on the sensors. The crew is dead, but something moves inside, and one of the shapes wears the face of someone in your crew.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterMonolithMoon: There is a black pillar on this moon. Nobody built it. Shadows sleep around it. Studying it could bring dark knowledge.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterBlackHoleEdge: Near the black hole's horizon, space bends. Void shards float outside, and something hungry for air came for them.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdPurgeDesc: Blow the room's air out at once. Hostiles in the room take damage and are stunned. Anyone unprotected starts to suffocate.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgVoidSensor: The void sensor detected {0} entities on the map.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdVoidPulseDesc: Wake every sleeping entity on the map, so you fight when you choose.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LessonDesc: Change the lesson subject. Piloting trains shooting and intellectual, engineering trains construction and crafting, medicine trains medicine and intellectual.
LanguageData.Rimverse_WasteNeedsSpace: Only works in space or in orbit.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdEnterSystemDesc: Take the ship from this Odyssey orbital location to the home world's orbit on the Rimverse map, where it can travel the system and the stars.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdDockOdysseyDesc: Take the ship to an Odyssey orbital location you already have open, like a relay or an asteroid.
LanguageData.Rimverse_NoDockSpace: There is no free space to dock the ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterOrbitTrader: A merchant ship from {0} reached orbit. Use the comms console to trade.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterOrbitPatrol: A patrol from {0} passed, scanned your position and moved on in peace. Their opinion of you improved a little.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterOrbitPatrolHostile: A patrol from {0}, at war with you, found your position and sent troops.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterOrbitFleet: Sensors spotted a fleet from {0} heading your way. They arrive in about two days.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterOrbitDerelict: Wreckage from a ship drifted close and some of it got caught here. There is material to salvage.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AlertDrillEmptyDesc: These deep drills have nothing left to dig. Move them.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AlertLowPowerDesc: A power net is using more than it makes and its batteries are below 15%.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ArsenalAlert: Boarding alert: {0} colonists armed from this armory.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ArsenalReady: Ready. Arms the crew when enemies show up.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdCopyBillsDesc: Copy all bills of this workbench.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdPasteBillsDesc: Paste the copied bills this workbench can do.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdCopyWorkDesc: Copy priorities, schedule and allowed area.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdPasteWorkDesc: Paste the copied priorities, schedule and area.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdWorkModeDesc: Change the work mode of the selected colonists.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdHuntDesc: The colonist hunts the nearest enemy on their own while drafted.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdSavePosDesc: Save this spot as the colonist's defensive position.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdGoPosDesc: Send the colonist to the saved defensive position.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdHarvestOnDesc: Switch off to pause harvesting here without losing the crop.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdStorageOnDesc: Switch off to stop storing things here without losing the settings.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdNeededModeDesc: The bay picks the plant whose crop the ship is shortest on.
LanguageData.Rimverse_DesHaulAreaDesc: Drag to mark every loose item in the area for hauling.
LanguageData.Rimverse_DesCopyDesc: Drag over an area to copy its buildings.
LanguageData.Rimverse_DesPasteDesc: Click to paste the copied buildings as blueprints.
LanguageData.Rimverse_HudColony: Food for {0} days · power {1} Wd ({2} W)
LanguageData.Rimverse_HydroNeedsGravity: Stopped: needs gravity. Only the closed-cycle garden works in zero gravity.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MedPodInspect: Tends on its own every hour (quality {0}).
LanguageData.Rimverse_PowerNetLine: Net {0} ({1} parts): makes {2} W, uses {3} W, balance {4} W
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterDefendStellarch: A Stellarch's ship calls for help: pirates have surrounded it close by. The pirate ship has turned on you. Win the battle to earn the Empire's favor.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterStellarchSaved: The Stellarch thanks the crew. {0} received {1} imperial favor.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterEscortNoble: The Empire asked that {0} travel aboard your ship for 5 days. Keep the noble alive and on their feet until the shuttle picks them up.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterNobleDone: The imperial shuttle picked up the noble. {0} received {1} imperial favor.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterNobleFailed: {0} fell under your protection. The Empire will not forget.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterHuntDeserters: {0} imperial deserters stole drop pods and are landing here. The Empire pays in favor if they are stopped.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterDesertersDone: The deserters were stopped. {0} received {1} imperial favor.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterPromotion: After another victory in space, {0} is now {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgConvoyEscort: Imperial escorts will fly with your ship for 5 days.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgCrewRescue: The imperial medical team tended {0} wounds.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgSensorsBlinded: Psychic static blinded {0} enemies and the sensors of enemy ships.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgShipyardRepair: The imperial shipyard crew repaired {0} buildings.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PsyNeedShield: Must be aboard one of your ships with a shield generator.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_Shipwreck:
The escape pods hit the ground hard. Around you lie the broken pieces of your ship: a bridge, an engine, fuel cells and the air generator. None of them work yet.
Repair them, research the ship basics and build a sealed hull around them. Then launch to orbit and look for a way to the stars.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_Drifting:
The alarms woke you up. The ship is drifting at the edge of the system, the air tanks are almost empty and the fuel gauge is in the red.
Check the ship tab: air, heat and fuel. Fix the damaged parts, grow food in the hydroponics and find a way to reach a planet or a station before the air runs out.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_MiningStation:
The contract is signed. Your station floats in the asteroid belt, far from the home world.
Use the mining suits to work the asteroids, sell the ore to the corporate traders and expand the station. With enough money you can build engines and become free.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_ImperialRefugees:
The jump was rough and the hull is cracked in several places. Behind you an imperial world is falling, and the Empire does not forgive deserters.
Repair the ship, keep the crew calm and look for civilizations that might take you in. Check the civilizations tab: the Empire already knows who you are.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_GlitterColony:
The federation shuttle left you here with crates of supplies and a promise of support.
You already know the basics of starships and sensors. Build your base, trade with the federation and, when you are ready, build your first ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_StarTribe:
The elders say the lights in the sky are spirits. The young ones say they are boats that sail between the stars.
Survive, grow and learn. The road to space is the longest one in Rimverse, but every civilization out there started like you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_CryoAwakening:
The caskets hiss open. Your heads hurt, and the ship clock says eighty years have passed.
The star catalog is out of date and the civilizations nearby are strangers now. Scan the sky, find out who rules the stars and decide where to go.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_RichExplorer:
Your ship is ready. The hydroponics are growing, the galley is warm and the drones are humming in their bay.
Open the galaxy map, pick a star and jump. Ruins, anomalies, civilizations and whole galaxies are waiting. The recommended storyteller for this start is a calm one.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GameStart_AsyncResearcher:
The yellow lights hum. You are back in the Yellow Rooms, with no idea how you got here.
Survive and find a way out. They say that this time the door back does not lead to the planet, but to an abandoned ship in orbit.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartSummary_Surface: Starts on the surface of the home world.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartSummary_Orbit: Starts in orbit of the home world.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartSummary_Belt: Starts in the asteroid belt of the home system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartSummary_OuterSystem: Starts at the edge of the home system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLayout_Drifter: Small ship without warp, low on air and fuel.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLayout_Explorer: Large automated ship with a warp drive.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLetterText_Drifter: The ship is at the edge of the system, far from everything. Air and fuel are low. Take care of them first.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLetterText_Station: The station sits in the asteroid belt. The corporation already knows you and will send traders.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLetterText_Refugee: The transport reached the edge of the system. The hull is cracked and the Empire is angry with you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLetterText_Explorer: The ship is in orbit of the home world, with everything running on its own. The universe is yours.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLetterText_CryoShip: The caskets opened after eighty years. The nearby civilizations changed while you slept.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLetterText_Derelict: An abandoned ship waits in orbit.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StartLetterText_AsyncExit: The door did not lead to the planet. You are inside an abandoned ship in orbit, with a damaged hull, little air and almost no fuel. Repair the ship and look for an A-sync Institute station.
LanguageData.Rimverse_DronesInspect: Drones repair {0} HP per hour (total repaired: {1}).
LanguageData.Rimverse_GalleyToggleDesc: Turns the automatic galley on or off.
